fusions.name: Herd Surge
fusions.desc: Drives a surge of hooves through a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything caught in it, and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Shouldering Trot
fusions.desc: A shoulder barge that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Lost in the Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you all move 20% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks for whoever attacks.

fusions.name: Grazing on the Move
fusions.desc: Each time you regain health, you also regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
